fields.summary_ko.0: Tesla's (TSLA) handle-free Cybercab is priced at $29,990 but requires a mandatory $299/month autonomous driving subscription (totaling approximately $47,631 over 5 years).
fields.summary_ko.1: Tesla began accepting orders from selected customers on November 13, at which time the stock price was $390.22 (−1.82%), with a market cap of approximately $1.54 trillion.
